fix_hint: Generate session IDs with crypto.randomBytes (or crypto.randomUUID), not Math.random.
Validate name against an allowlist or resolve and check it stays within SESSION_DIR before reading.
Handle the fs.writeFile error in the callback (or use fs.promises.writeFile with await) instead of swallowing it.
Update lastSeen synchronously; deferring via setTimeout lets concurrent destroySession resurrect a deleted session.
Use crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers (and strict ===) to compare CSRF tokens.
